strategy.thesis: FutuRx is an Israeli biopharma incubator founded by Johnson & Johnson Innovation (JJDC), Takeda Ventures and OrbiMed Israel Partners together with the Israel Innovation Authority, and later joined by Leaps by Bayer, to originate and fund early-stage drug-development ventures built on Israeli academic science.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Incubates de novo biopharma companies out of Israeli academic research; partners include OrbiMed Israel Partners for scientific/investment diligence.

program.eligibility: Early-stage biopharma ventures based on Israeli academic science

summary.en: FutuRx is a Rehovot-based biopharma incubator, jointly founded by J&J Innovation, Takeda Ventures, OrbiMed Israel Partners and the Israel Innovation Authority (with Leaps by Bayer joining later), that creates and funds early-stage drug-development companies.

sources.title: Mission - FutuRx
sources.quote: FutuRx was founded by Johnson & Johnson Innovation – JJDC, Takeda Pharmaceutical Company, through its venture group Takeda Ventures Inc.-TVI and OrbiMed Israel Partners together with the Israeli Innovation Authority of the Ministry of Economy

sources.title: First Companies Move Into FutuRx Biotech Incubator In Israel
sources.quote: FutuRX is located in Rehovot, and it became operational on January 1st 2014

verification_notes: Founding-partner and location facts corroborated across official site and PR Newswire; portfolio detail not independently re-verified in this pass.

strategy.thesis: MEDX Xelerator is an Israel Innovation Authority-licensed medical-device incubator, founded by MEDX Ventures Group, Boston Scientific, Intellectual Ventures and Sheba Medical Center, providing seed funding, an in-house lab (X-Lab) and clinical/regulatory support to ventures in vascular intervention, interventional cardiology, urology, interventional oncology, medical robotics and remote-therapy digital health.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Operates an in-house professional laboratory (X-Lab) for creative solution development, plus a network of scientific/clinical advisors.

summary.en: MEDX Xelerator is Israel's leading medical-device incubator, backed by Boston Scientific, Sheba Medical Center and Intellectual Ventures, offering up to $1.1M in funding plus an in-house lab to medtech and digital-health startups.

sources.title: Home - MEDX Xelerator
sources.supports: founding year/partners, focus areas, investment amounts, lab space, portfolio
sources.quote: Over $800,000 for a period of 2 years and up to $1.1 million for a period of 3 years

sources.title: Edge Medical Ventures Launches New $70 Million MedTech Fund
sources.quote: Since 2018, MEDX has launched and invested in 18 medical device companies, shaping a new generation of healthcare innovation.

verification_notes: Founded 2015 per official site; MEDX's own later press release cites '18 medical device companies since 2018' which differs slightly from the site's 16+ portfolio count, likely a timing difference between snapshots.

strategy.thesis: Sanara Ventures is a Teva- and Philips-backed seed-stage investment platform for Israeli digital-health and medtech startups (disease management, patient monitoring, imaging, drug-delivery devices, minimally-invasive devices); its follow-on arm Sanara Capital (est. 2023) invests at Series A/B in digital health, bio-convergence and medical devices.

summary.en: Sanara Ventures, a Teva + Philips joint venture based in Ra'anana, is a seed-stage medtech/digital-health incubator-investor whose follow-on fund Sanara Capital backs Series A/B rounds in digital health, bio-convergence and medical devices.

sources.title: Philips, Teva venture firm looks to invest $26M in Israeli med tech
sources.quote: spend about $26 million to support up to 50 digital health and med tech companies over the next 8 years

sources.title: Sanara Capital
sources.supports: current structure, Sanara Capital follow-on fund
sources.quote: Sanara Capital is a dedicated Health-Tech fund established in 2023, specializing in Digital Health, Bio-Convergence, and Medical Devices, and is a follow-on fund of Sanara Ventures

verification_notes: Sanara has evolved from a seed-stage incubator (Sanara Ventures) into a two-tier platform with a Series A/B follow-on fund (Sanara Capital); treated here as one entity per its own site framing.

strategy.thesis: RAD BioMed is the life-sciences investment arm of the RAD-Bynet group, an accelerator/investor that provides seed and Series A capital, physical lab infrastructure and business-development support to early-stage Israeli biopharma, medical-device, diagnostics and digital-health startups.

summary.en: RAD BioMed is a Tel Aviv-based accelerator and investment platform, the life-sciences arm of the RAD-Bynet group, backing early-stage Israeli biopharma, medtech, diagnostics and digital-health companies with seed/Series A capital and lab infrastructure.

sources.title: Home | radbiomed
sources.quote: invest in early-stage, preferably seed, biomedical startups with new solutions or proprietary technology in biopharmaceuticals and medical devices

sources.title: RAD BioMed - Israeli Incubator | Startup Nation Finder
sources.quote: RAD BioMed - Israeli Incubator | Startup Nation Finder

verification_notes: Founding year and exact HQ address not independently confirmed beyond secondary listings; classified by Startup Nation Central as both accelerator and incubator.

strategy.thesis: AION Labs is an AI-driven drug-discovery venture-creation lab founded by AstraZeneca, Merck, Pfizer, Teva, the Israel Biotech Fund and AWS after winning an Israel Innovation Authority tender; based beside the Weizmann Institute in Rehovot, it spins out new AI-native biotech ventures (e.g. DenovAI, TenAces Biosciences) rather than investing in existing companies.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Co-located with the Weizmann Institute of Science; bridges academic AI/ML research with pharma R&D needs to found new companies in-house.

summary.en: AION Labs is a Rehovot-based AI drug-discovery venture studio backed by AstraZeneca, Merck, Pfizer, Teva, the Israel Biotech Fund and AWS, founding new AI-native biotech companies such as DenovAI and TenAces Biosciences.

sources.title: AION Labs, Biotech Innovation Lab Launched by Top Pharma, Tech and Investment Leaders
sources.quote: AION Labs, a first-of-its-kind innovation lab spearheading the adoption of AI technologies and computational science to solve therapeutic challenges, announced its official launch and the opening of its international headquarters in Rehovot, Israel on October 13, 2021

sources.title: Israel lab backed by pharma giants mints startup for computer-designed antibodies
sources.quote: AION Labs introduced DenovAI, a venture focused on antibody discovery through an AI-powered computational platform

strategy.thesis: eHealth Ventures is an Israel Innovation Authority-licensed digital-health incubator founded with Maccabi Healthcare Services and Cleveland Clinic Innovations, and backed by Amgen and Medison Pharma, focused on diagnostics, digital monitoring/treatment, home care and bio-convergence.

summary.en: eHealth Ventures is an Israeli digital-health incubator and VC platform founded with Maccabi Healthcare Services and Cleveland Clinic Innovations, backed by Amgen, that has evaluated ~1,800 startups and invested in 35 digital-health companies.

sources.title: eHealth Ventures raises $30 million for digital health fund
sources.supports: founding partners, fund size, portfolio count
sources.quote: eHealth has reviewed around 1,800 startups in the field and invested in 35 companies

sources.title: Amgen To Invest In Israel-Based eHealth Ventures

verification_notes: Sources conflict on founding year (2015 per MobiHealthNews founding-partners account vs. 2016 per Israel Innovation Authority selection / another account); exact HQ city not confirmed in this pass.

strategy.thesis: Trendlines Medical is an Israel Innovation Authority-franchised medical-device incubator operated by the publicly traded Trendlines Group (SGX: 42T; OTCQX: TRNLY), based in the Misgav region of the Western Galilee, that hands-on invents, invests in and incubates medtech innovations from technology development through commercialization.

program.eligibility: Innovation-based medical technologies (peripheral-area government incubator franchise)

summary.en: Trendlines Medical is the medtech incubator arm of the publicly traded Trendlines Group, operating under an Israel Innovation Authority government-incubator franchise in the Misgav region since the 1990s, hands-on inventing and building medical-device companies.

sources.title: Trendlines Medical Wins Israeli Government Technology Incubator Tender
sources.quote: The Trendlines Medical incubator is located in the Misgav region of Israel's Western Galilee, classified as a peripheral area by the Government

sources.title: The Trendlines Group - Israeli Incubator | Startup Nation Finder

verification_notes: Trendlines Group also runs Trendlines Agtech (out of scope for this bio/health slice); founded_year (1993) refers to the parent Group per Crunchbase-sourced snippet, not necessarily the medical incubator's government-franchise start date.

strategy.thesis: Edge Medical Ventures is an Israel Innovation Authority-selected deep-tech medical-device incubator/venture-builder, founded by the MEDX Xelerator leadership team and backed by Boston Scientific, Edge Medical Partners, Issec Capital (CBG), Hadassah, Sheba and Wolfson medical centers, Cornell University Medical Center and Hadasit, combining hardware, software, biology and materials engineering.

investment.raw: up to NIS 40m public funding over 5 years, plus tens of millions of dollars independently invested

summary.en: Edge Medical Ventures, founded by MEDX Xelerator's leadership team and backed by Boston Scientific plus Hadassah, Sheba and Wolfson medical centers, is an Israel Innovation Authority-selected deep-tech medical-device incubator using a venture creation/building studio model.

sources.title: Edge Medical Ventures Launches New $70 Million MedTech Fund
Israel Innovation Authority Picks Deep Tech Incubators to Launch Startups with 5-year Investment of Hundreds of Millions
sources.quote: Edge Medical Ventures to establish, invest in, and support dozens of deeptech startups in Israel as part of an innovative venture creation and building studio model... total budget of up to NIS 40m over five years

verification_notes: Recently established (deep-tech incubator selection round, 2024-2025 timeframe); exact founding year and HQ city not precisely confirmed in this pass.

strategy.thesis: Nucleate Israel is the Israeli chapter of Nucleate, a global student-run nonprofit running the equity-free 'Activator' program that trains PhD/Master's/postdoc academic founders (Bio and Eco tracks) to translate life-science research into venture-backable biotech companies; endorsed by Israel's Bio-Convergence Initiative and the Israel Innovation Authority.

program.eligibility: PhD students, Master's students, or postdocs with academic life-science/biotech research

summary.en: Nucleate Israel is the Israeli chapter of the global student-run nonprofit Nucleate, running a six-month equity-free Activator program that helps PhD/postdoc researchers turn academic life-science discoveries into biotech venture theses.

sources.title: Israel - Nucleate
sources.quote: Israel's Bio-Convergence Initiative has endorsed Nucleate, with the Israeli Innovation Authority's CTO noting they are imbuing technology development with a new strategic lens and a connected global community

sources.title: Activator - Nucleate
sources.quote: Activator is a six-month, equity-free cohort program designed for academic biotech founders

verification_notes: Non-dilutive, student-run educational accelerator rather than a capital-deploying fund; included because it is a dedicated bio/health venture-creation program with a documented Israel chapter.

strategy.thesis: Incentive is an Israel Innovation Authority-licensed technological incubator managed by Peregrine Ventures since 2002, giving priority to bioconvergence ventures (biology + engineering + materials science); strategic partners include Merck KGaA, Bristol-Myers Squibb, Becton Dickinson, Elbit Systems, Tel Aviv University, Ben-Gurion University and Shaare Zedek Medical Center.

summary.en: Incentive is a Peregrine Ventures-managed, Israel Innovation Authority-licensed technological incubator in Or Yehuda that has supported over 60 companies since 2002, prioritizing bioconvergence ventures with strategic partners Merck KGaA, BMS, Becton Dickinson and Elbit Systems.

sources.title: Merck joins Incentive incubator as strategic partner
sources.supports: founding year, managing firm, partners, track record
sources.quote: Incentive, based in Or Yehuda and managed by Peregrine since 2002, has supported the formation and growth of more than 60 companies, including Valtech, CartiHeal, and CardioValve

sources.title: Merck KGaA Becomes Strategic Partner in Peregrine Ventures' Incentive Incubator
sources.quote: Other partners involved in the Incentive Incubator include Bristol-Myers Squibb, Becton Dickinson, Elbit Systems, Tel Aviv University, Ben-Gurion University, and Shaare Zedek Medical Center
